column1: # Which Record Atlas region (regions.json) each place string this archive prints on a person's page belongs to, for the 'at the time' notes

# string in people.json fails tools/build_era.py --check until it is decided here. Mapped by hand against the Atlas's regions; erasnap.py then refuses
